name: Overturn Environmental Protection Agency rule: National Emission Standards for Hazardous Air Pollutants: Coal- and Oil-Fired Electric Utility Steam Generating Units: Final Repeal
official: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Environmental Protection Agency relating to "National Emission Standards for Hazardous Air Pollutants: Coal- and Oil-Fired Electric Utility Steam Generating Units: Final Repeal".

timeline.text: Motion to proceed to consideration of measure rejected in Senate by Yea-Nay Vote. 46 - 53. Record Vote Number: 135. (CR S2509)
timeline.label: Motion to proceed
timeline.explain: Vote to begin debating the measure. Not passage.

timeline.text: Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 409.

timeline.text: Senate Committee on Environment and Public Works discharged, by petition, pursuant to 5 U.S.C. 802(c).

timeline.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Environment and Public Works.
